title: Thinking Machines, OpenAI and the impact gap
description: MANILA-based Thinking Machines Data Science is one of 30 companies worldwide recognized as an OpenAI Advanced Partner. The designation, announced at an Aug. 14 media briefing in Makati City and formalized in a joint statement four days later, expands the firm’s role in reselling ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Business and ChatGPT Edu to Philippine organizations. Founded in 2015, Thinking Machines says it has served more than 150 clients and trained 12,000 professionals since, with 95 percent of its artificial intelligence (AI) pilots reaching production. Panelists kept coming back to one thing that morning: whether all that activity was paying off for Filipino companies.

title: Warsh raises stakes for Fed's next meeting and other takeaways from Jackson Hole conference
description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh provided his most detailed insights yet on how he views the central bank's fight against inflation in a high-profile speech an at annual economic conference in Jackson Hole Friday. In saying that he hasn't seen evidence that inflation is cooling, Warsh put more pressure on the Fed to increase interest rates when it next meets in mid-September. It's unclear if the Fed does hike short-term rates soon whether long-term rates would follow and lead to higher borrowing costs for consumers. Warsh also reiterated his belief that artificial intelligence has the ability to make the economy more efficient.
content:
